newsitem.title: USA: 76 Products Co opens Calif. crude terminal.
newsitem.headline: 76 Products Co opens Calif. crude terminal.

text.p: Unocal Corp's 76 Products Company opened a $21 million crude oil terminal here Wednesday, as part of an overland link between production fields in California's San Joaquin Valley and its Los Angeles-area refinery.

The facility forms the nucleus of a system that will allow the company to send nearly 40,000 barrels of crude oil daily to the company's 120,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Carson, Calif., the company said in a statement.
"We were faced with a challenge to keep crude oil flowing to our Los Angeles refinery so we could continue to serve our customers," Larry Higby, president of 76 Products, said in the statement.
The terminal includes four 60,000 barrel tanks which will receive oil from the All American Pipeline at a hourly rate of about 8,500 barrels, the company said.
The oil will then load onto rail cars for delivery to the company's Carson refinery.
